simple.meaning: מִסְפֵּד (miçpêd) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a lamentation.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 14 times in Genesis, Esther, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 50:10. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, commandment, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִסְפֵּד (H4553) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מִסְפֵּד (miçpêd) / H4553 is traced through Genesis 50:10, Esther 4:3, Psalms 30:12, Isaiah 22:12 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H4553. misped מִסְמֵּד noun masculine Gen 50:10 wailing ; — absolute ׳מ Amos 5:16 11 t.; construct מִסְמַּד Micah 1:11 2 t.; suffix מִסְמְּדִי Psa 30:12 ; — wailing: 1 for dead , Gen 50:10 (J; as accusative of congnate meaning with verb), Zech 12:10 (with עַלֿ ; compare 12:11 ; 12:11 below). 2 for calamity experienced Amos 5:16 (twice in verse) (|| אֵבֶל ), vAmos 5:17; Micah 1:8 ( ׳מ כַּתַּנִּים , || אֵבֶל ), 1:11 ; Jer 48:38 ; Ezek 27:31 , anticipated Jer 6:26 ; Est 4:3 . 3 in contrition Isa 22:12 (+ בְּכִי ), Joel 2:12 (+ בְּכִי צוֺם, ), compare Zech 12:11 (twice in verse). 4 in General, Psa 30:12 (opposed to מָחוֺל , compare Eccl 3:4 ).
